messages:
June (partnerships): Heads-up: vendor PMs want a very small "starter" listing to unblock approvals. Goal: minimal metadata + trial + manifest. Can we scope to the absolute minimum?
Tess (product): Yes. Minimum fields: display_name, short_description, skus[], support_contact. I'll draft values.
Arman (eng): Minimal manifest for each cloud: image/ami, health_check, env instructions. Example for container:
```
name: redwood-inference
version: 1.0.0
image: registry.redwood/release:marketplace-1
health_check: /ready
regions: [us-west1]
```
Keep it trimmed.
June (partnerships): Good. Legal needs trial language copy and privacy flag for EU.
Leah (legal): Draft blurb: "14-day trial. Billing begins after trial unless canceled. Data processed per regional controls." Short enough to fit tile link.
Tess (product): Tile headline: "Redwood Inference — Fast LLM inference" CTA: "Start trial". Secondary bullets limited to two.
Arman (eng): Also note: vendor CI will call health_check and require a staging image tag. I'll push staging:registry.redwood/release:staging and share creds.
listing-bot: Starter listing checklist updated: manifest_added true; legal_blurb pending -> true; staging_image_uploaded true.
June (partnerships): Action items: Tess publish catalog metadata, Arman push staging image + manifest to shared repo, Leah confirm blurb and EULA link. Will ping vendor PMs once done.
Tess (product): I'll upload metadata by EOD PT.
Leah (legal): EULA link: https://redwood.ai/eula/marketplace. I'll confirm final footnote by 3pm.
